info.title: Luanti Education Platform
info.description: Interface of the LEP backend for the web frontend and the worlds.

get.summary:
Says whether the backend can do its work, and nothing else: everybody
may ask. The details are for teachers, under `/api/web/v1/status`.

post.summary:
Confirms the address a teacher entered at the desk, with the token
from the confirmation mail. A token works once.

400.description: The token is unknown, used or too old (invalid_token), or the request cannot be read (invalid_request)

409.description: The address belongs to another account (address_taken)

get.summary:
Lists the groups of the teacher: all of them for the school
administration, else the ones the teacher is assigned to.

200.description: The groups the teacher may see

get.summary:
Shows one group. A group the teacher may not see does not exist for
them.

404.description: No such group for this teacher (not_found)

patch.summary:
Renames a group, sets its teachers or both. Only the school
administration may do this.

200.description: The group as it is now

400.description: The name cannot be used or an account is not a teacher (invalid_request)

get.summary: Lists the accounts of the students of a group.

200.description: The accounts, in the order they were rolled

404.description: No such group for this teacher (not_found)

post.summary:
Rolls names for new accounts. Nothing happens in the world yet: the
names are drafts that can be rolled again or removed.

400.description: The count is not allowed or the group would get too large (invalid_request)

404.description: No such group for this teacher (not_found)

post.summary:
Has the world create an account for every draft of the group and
returns the access slips with the start passwords. The passwords are
shown this once: the backend does not keep them.

400.description: There is no draft to create (invalid_request)

404.description: No such group for this teacher (not_found)

delete.summary: Removes a name that is not an account in the world.

404.description: No such group, or no such name that could still be changed (not_found)

post.summary:
Makes up a new start password for the account of a student and asks
the world to set it. The password is shown this once. Until the world
has set it, the old one counts.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: The account that gets a new password

404.description: No such group, or no such account that exists in the world (not_found)

post.summary: Replaces a name that is not an account yet by a newly rolled one.

404.description: No such group, or no such name that could still be changed (not_found)

post.summary:
Logs a teacher in with the token from a login mail and sets the
session cookie. A token works once.

200.description: Logged in, the session cookie is set

400.description: The token is unknown, used or too old (invalid_token), or the request cannot be read (invalid_request)

post.summary:
Sends a mail with a login link to an address, if a teacher may log in
with it. The answer is the same in every case, so nobody learns here
which addresses are known.

200.description: Taken note of, whether or not a mail goes out

post.summary:
Ends the session of the request and removes the cookie. Without a
session nothing happens.

get.summary:
Says how the backend is doing, with the details that are nobody
else's business.

Lists the accounts that can be assigned to groups. Only the school
administration may ask.

200.description: Everybody who holds the privilege for web access

post.summary:
Takes in events of a world. Every event is handled once, however often
it is sent.

413.description: Too many events in one request

get.summary:
Returns the jobs that wait for a world. If there are none, the request
stays open for up to `wait` seconds and returns as soon as one comes.

404.description: The world has no such job

AccessSlip.description: What a student needs to log in for the first time.

password.description:
The start password. The backend shows it this once and does
not keep it.

AccessSlips.description: Answer to creating accounts: the slips to print.

AccountsCreated.description:
Payload of the event "accounts_created": what became of the
accounts a world was asked to create.

created.description: Names of the accounts that exist now, with the start password.

refused.description:
Names that were refused: taken by somebody else in this world,
or not a name the engine accepts. Nothing was changed for them.

ApiError.description: Answer to a request that failed.

message.description:
What went wrong, in English, for logs and developers. It is not
shown to users.

ConfirmRequest.description: Request to confirm an address with the token from a mail.

account.description: Account name of the teacher the address now belongs to.

Done.description: Answer to a request that needs nothing said.

DraftRequest.description: Request to roll names for new accounts.

ErrorCode.description:
Why a request failed, as a fixed word. The frontend translates it into
the language of the user.

Event.description: One thing that happened in a world.

id.description:
Unique id, made up by the world. The backend uses it to notice
an event it has seen before.

kind.description:
What happened, for example "world_started". It decides what
the payload has to look like.

payload.description: The details, depending on the kind.

time.description: When it happened, in seconds since 1970 (UTC).

EventBatch.description: Several events in one request, oldest first.

EventBatchResult.description: Answer to a batch: one result per event, in the same order.

EventOutcome.description:
What the backend did with an event. In every case the world may
forget the event: sending it again would change nothing.

EventResult.description: The outcome for one event of a batch.

Group.description: A group. It is the home of one world, one to one.

address.description:
Where players reach the world, for example
`spiel.schule.example, Port 30000`. It is printed on the
access slips. Missing until somebody entered it.

id.description: Fixed identifier of the group and its world.

last_seen_at.description:
When the world of the group last called, in seconds since
1970 (UTC). Missing if it never did.

name.description: Name for people. It can be changed.

teachers.description:
Account names of the teachers who are assigned to the group,
sorted.

address.description:
Where players reach the world, if it changes. An empty text
removes it.

name.description: The new name, if it changes.

teachers.description:
The teachers of the group from now on, if they change. The
list replaces the old one.

Groups.description: The groups a teacher may see.

Health.description:
Answer of the health check. Everybody may ask, so it says nothing
but whether the backend can do its work.

HealthStatus.description: Whether the backend can do its work.

Job.description: Something the backend wants a world to do.

kind.description:
What to do, for example "ping". It decides what the payload has
to look like.

JobList.description: The jobs that wait for a world. Empty if none came in time.

message.description: A short note, for example why it failed.

Level.description: One level of a module: its workload.

stage.description: True if completing this level ends a stage of the module.

LoginLinkRequest.description: Request for a mail with a link that logs in.

email.description: The confirmed address of the teacher.

LoginRequest.description: Request to log in with the token from a mail.

Me.description: The teacher who is logged in.

email.description: The confirmed address of the teacher.

expires_at.description: When the session ends, in seconds since 1970 (UTC).

school_admin.description:
True if the teacher belongs to the school administration:
they see every group and assign teachers to groups.

worlds.description:
Names of the worlds in which the teacher holds the privilege
for web access.

Module.description: A learning module as a world knows it.

title.description: Name for people, in the language of the world.

Modules.description:
Payload of the event "modules": all modules of the world. It
replaces what the backend knew before.

NewAccount.description: An account a world shall create.

password.description: The start password. The world stores only its hash.

PasswordState.description: How far a new start password for an account is.

Progress.description:
Payload of the event "progress": where one student stands in one
module. It is the whole state, not a change, and replaces what the
backend knew before.

completed.description: True if the whole module is completed.

locked.description: True if moving up after a completed level is locked.

percent.description: Share of the workload of the level that is done, 0 to 100.

tasks.description: The kinds of tasks of the current level.

ProtocolEntry.description:
Payload of the event "protocol": one entry of one of the protocols
of a world. The time is the time of the event.

account.description:
Account name of the player the entry is about. Never a display
name.

fields.description: The other columns of the entry, by name.

SetPassword.description:
Payload of the job "set_password". A world sets the password only
for an ordinary account: one that holds nothing but what every new
player gets.

password.description: The new start password. The world stores only its hash.

Status.description:
State of the backend with its details, for teachers who are
logged in.

version.description: Version of the backend, as in its package.

account.description: Account name. It says nothing about the person.

oneOf.description:
Missing in the usual case: the password the student was given
last is the one that counts.

StudentState.description: How far the account of a student is.

Students.description:
The accounts of the students of a group, in the order they were
rolled. A name that is rolled again keeps its place.

TaskProgress.description: How far a student is with one kind of task of their level.

TaskType.description: A kind of task of a level, with how often it has to be solved.

title.description: Name for people, in the language of the world.

TeacherList.description:
The accounts that can be assigned to groups: everybody who holds
the privilege for web access in some world. Sorted.

Teachers.description:
Payload of the event "teachers": the accounts that hold the
privilege for web access in this world. It replaces what the
backend knew before.

school_admins.description:
The accounts that hold the privilege of the school
administration in this world.

Trophies.description:
Payload of the event "trophies": all trophies of one student. It
replaces what the backend knew before.

Trophy.description: A trophy a student has earned.

title.description: Name for people, in the language of the world.

WebAccessAction.description: What a teacher can do with their web access at the desk.

WebAccessRequest.description:
Payload of the event "web_access": what a teacher did with their
web access.

email.description: The address, for the action "set" only.

WebAccessStatus.description:
Payload of the job "web_access_status": how the web access of a
teacher stands. Addresses are shortened, the world never gets a
whole one back.

address.description: The confirmed address, shortened. Missing without one.

pending.description: The address that waits for its confirmation, shortened.

engine.description: Version of the game engine, as it names itself.

mods.description: Names of the mods that are loaded.
